notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Forensic Researcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
